response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, 1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts), differences AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_above_average DESC) AS position FROM differences) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share_above_average FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, district_id;
